# Data Source: identitynow_saved_search

Use this data source to look up a saved search by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_saved_search" "disabled_accounts" {
  id = "0de46054-fe90-434a-b84e-c6b3359d0c64"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Saved search ID.

### Read-Only

- `columns_json` (String) Columns per document type as a JSON object.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Saved search description.
- `fields` (List of String) Fields searched in a multi-field query.
- `filters_json` (String) Filters per field name as a JSON object.
- `indices` (List of String) Search indices.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Saved search name.
- `order_by` (Map of List of String) Map of document type to sort fields.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the identity that owns the saved search.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the saved search is public.
- `query` (String) Search query.
- `sort` (List of String) Fields the results are sorted by.
